marta: Heads-up: MedicaSys POC asked for SOC2 report, ISO artifacts, and a vendor-signed pen-test letter. They want KMS flow + encryption-at-rest detail. Target deadline: next Fri EOD.
diego: Do we have a standard pack for healthcare POCs?
marta: We have SOC2 summary + ISMS overview public. Full configs and screenshots are gated behind NDA. Pen-test letter is usually our standard CISO-signed doc.
nora-legal: If they request changes to the pen-test wording, it'll need legal review. Also clarify whether they expect remediation timelines inside the letter 10 business days will be tight if they want edits.
diego: For pricing ask: sales requested delta for Dedicated with 99th %-ile SLA. Ballpark anchor would help.
marta: I'll propose $10k/month base + $2k per reserved GPU for the POC as preliminary. Label as "estimate".
infra-bot: evidence-bucket created: s3://redwood-evidence/medicasys-235000 (restricted).
marta: Uploading SOC2-summary.pdf and standard-pen-test-letter.pdf to the bucket now, adding README with gating notes.
diego: Can we include a short list of contacts for their audit team? They often ask for an ops and infra contact.
marta: Added: diego (infra lead), marta (sales-ops).
nora-legal: Note: we do not provide raw logs or PCAPs. Offer to coordinate a joint observation session with our auditor if they need deeper evidence.
diego: Also call out redaction effort: estimate ~2 hours infra + 1 hour legal if they want ISO documents redacted. Finance wants that number.
marta: I'll include the redaction estimate in the packet.
infra-bot: temp-creds issued: voucher id vc-44321, expires in 48h.
diego: I'll prep a staging VPC and a scoped pen-test window; need their proposed schedule.
nora-legal: If they insist on SLA language for remediation, we'll need an addendum signed by procurement. I'll draft a template for that.
marta: Next steps: Marta (procurement follow-up + uploads), Diego (staging VPC + redaction script), Nora-legal (pen-test addendum draft). Deadline: EOD Friday for initial packet.
marta: Ping me with any procurement redlines. I'll add a short Q&A to README for common audit asks.
diego: Will book a 20m sync if legal wants to walk the network diagrams.
nora-legal: Happy to review.
marta: Uploaded README_v1.md with decision-tree for artifact gating and contact list. Marking packet ready for internal review. :thumbsup:
